The '''flatworm''' was a type of [[Sentience/Legends|nonsentient]] [[Worm/Legends|worm]]. The primitive [[nervous system]] of the [[Swokes Swokes/Legends|Swokes Swokes]]<ref name="GatORW" />&mdash;a sentient [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Species/Legends|species]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makem Te/Legends|Makem Te]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|202|Swokes Swokes}}</ref> of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Nilgaard sector/Legends|Nilgaard sector]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for the [[Makem system]]</ref> who lacked receptors for the sense of touch and as a result were nearly impervious to pain&mdash;was more similar to that of flatworms than those of other sentient<ref name="GatORW" /> humanoid species.<ref name="CSWE" />

==Behind the scenes==
In the real world, [[Wikipedia:Flatworm|flatworms]], constituting the [[Wikipedia:Phylum|phylum]] Platyhelminthes, are [[Wikipedia:Invertebrate|invertebrate]] animals that generally have a flattened body.<ref name="Flatworm">{{WebCite|url=https://www.britannica.com/animal/flatworm|text=Flatworm &#124; Reproduction, Examples, & Characteristics|author=The Editors of Encyclopædia Britannica|date=2026-02-04|work=[[Wikipedia:Encyclopædia Britannica|''Encyclopædia Britannica'']]|archivedate=20260105024213}}</ref>
